notes.title: 📢 New Game Mode: Defense Mode! 🔥
notes.notes:
Strengthen your defense line because [b]Cyber Zombies[/b] are coming! With the newly added [b]Defense Mode[/b], you can now take on the mission of protecting the reactor from relentless zombie attacks across three different maps!

[b]🛡️ Your Mission:[/b]
🔸 Defend the reactor on your chosen map.
🔸 Cyber Zombies will attack from all directions—stay alert!
🔸 Protect the reactor until the timer runs out to succeed.

[b]✅ Other Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
🔹 [b]Localization Fixes[/b] – Various translation and localization issues have been corrected.
🔹 [b]Subway Map Adjustments[/b] – Areas where players could exit the map have been closed off.
🔹 [b]Subway Map Bug Fix[/b] – A bug that caused players to get stuck in the elevator under certain conditions has been resolved.
🔹 [b]Case Restart Issue[/b] – An issue where cases entered an infinite loop when restarted from the scoring screen after completion has been fixed.
🔹 [b]Multiplayer Improvements[/b] – A game mode filter has been added to the "Host Game" and "Join Game" screens.

[b]📢 Your Feedback Matters![/b]
We are continuously working to improve your gameplay experience. Don’t forget to share your suggestions and feedback with us!

🕵️‍♂️ See you in the field, Detectives!
[b]– DeTechtive 2112 Team 🚀[/b]

notes.title: 📢 New Update! 📢
notes.notes:
🔧 [b]Latest Fixes and Improvements[/b]
✅ Optimized Memory Usage – DeTechtive 2112 now uses [b]70% less RAM[/b], ensuring a smoother experience.

✅ Reduced VRAM Requirements – Crashes caused by insufficient VRAM have been [b]minimized[/b], improving stability across a wider range of hardware.

✅ Optimized Disk Usage – The game’s file size has been [b]reduced by 35%[/b], requiring less storage space.

✅ Faster Game Startup – The game now [b]launches significantly faster[/b]. The issue causing delays on the main menu screen has been fixed.

✅ Enhanced Enemy AI Positioning – Enemy AI now [b]positions itself more effectively during combat[/b], leading to more dynamic encounters.

✅ Localization Fixes – Various [b]translation and localization errors have been corrected[/b].

✅ Fatal Error Fixes – Multiple [b]Fatal Error crashes have been resolved[/b], enhancing overall stability.

✅ Save Data Cleanup – When starting a new game, [b]previous case data is now properly cleared[/b].



📢 [b]Your Feedback Matters![/b]
We are committed to continuously improving DeTechtive 2112 based on your input. Share your thoughts and let us know what you'd like to see next!

🕵️‍♂️ See you in the field, Detectives!
– The DeTechtive 2112 Team 🚀

notes.title: Post-Launch Dev Log & Latest Updates!
notes.notes:
Detectives, we’re beyond grateful for the incredible response to DeTechtive 2112! It’s been [b]only one week since launch[/b], and thanks to your feedback, the game is continuously improving. Your insights have been invaluable, and we’re committed to making DeTechtive 2112 even better. Here’s a look at the latest updates and improvements we’ve made:


🔧[b] Recent Fixes & Improvements[/b]
✅ Stealth Mechanics Adjusted – We’ve made stealth gameplay smoother and more accessible. Sneaking past enemies is now easier than before!

✅ AI Vision Overhaul – Enemy AI can no longer see behind them, creating a more natural and fair stealth experience.

✅ Lighting Improvements – We’ve reworked the lighting across different maps to better capture the game’s atmosphere. Environments now feel more immersive and visually striking.

✅ Fatal Error Fix – Some players encountered a Fatal Error issue on the death screen. This has been resolved for a smoother experience.

✅ Boss Fight Balancing – Boss battles have been adjusted for better difficulty balance. Bosses can no longer be taken down instantly with a Taser, making fights more challenging and rewarding.

🔄 [b]What We’re Working on Next[/b]
🔹 Co-op Connection Enhancements – We’re continuing to refine matchmaking and network stability.
🔹 Gameplay Balancing – Weapons and enemy behaviors are being adjusted to improve overall game balance.
🔹 Mission Variety & QoL Tweaks – We’re looking into diversifying objectives and refining mechanics for an even better experience.
🔹 AI Translations Under Review – We’re actively reviewing and improving AI-generated translations within our possibilities for better accuracy and immersion.



👀 [b]Addressing Player Concerns[/b]
❓ Single-Player Mode? – While DeTechtive 2112 is designed as a co-op experience, we’re exploring ways to improve solo play.

❓ More Content? – We’re working on additional updates, including new challenges and features to keep the experience fresh and extend playtime.

⭐ We’d love to hear your ideas on what kind of extra content you’d like to see! Share your suggestions, and we’ll work on expanding DeTechtive 2112 within our possibilities, together with you. 


🚀 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
We’re fully dedicated to supporting DeTechtive 2112 with continuous updates and new content. Additionally, we’re preparing for our upcoming console launch—stay tuned for more details soon!

🎉 Exciting News! We’re also participating in the Steam Co-op Fest on February 10! Get ready for special events and even more ways to experience DeTechtive 2112 with friends! 🚀

⭐ We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join us on Discord and the Steam Community Forums to share feedback and report any issues.

See you in the field, Cyber Detectives! 🕵️‍♂️🔍

– The DeTechtive 2112 Team

notes.title: DeTechtive 2112 is out now!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that DeTechtive 2112 is officially available on Steam today! 🚀

🌆 Neon-Noir Exploration
Immerse yourself in the atmospheric cyberpunk world of DeTechtive 2112. Navigate rain-soaked streets and neon-lit alleys, uncovering secrets hidden within a city’s crumbling remains. From shadowy backstreets to towering skyscrapers, every location tells a story, drawing you deeper into a gripping noir mystery.

🕵️‍♂️ Tactical Mystery-Solving
Take on 5 interconnected cases, each with its own unique challenges and mini-story. Choose your approach: investigate clues, sneak past threats, or engage in intense combat. Your choices and strategy determine how each case unfolds as you piece together the truth behind the city’s dark secrets.

🤝 Cooperative or Solo Gameplay
Team up with up to 4 players or work solo as you solve cases in DeTechtive 2112. Collaborate on strategy, divide tasks, or go it alone to tackle challenges your way. Whether through stealth, combat, or cunning, every decision shapes your path toward unraveling a larger mystery.

We would be delighted if you could share your experience and feedback with us!

notes.title: Developer's Log 5
notes.notes:
[b]Hello DeTechtive 2112 Community,[/b]

We’ve been hard at work improving the game based on your valuable feedback. Here’s a breakdown of the latest updates and new features we’ve added:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/e3cd8cb8a66f0f293de752416192bca2fb699aef.png[/img]

[h3]HDR Support[/h3]
DeTechtive 2112 now supports HDR (High Dynamic Range)! This feature enhances the cyberpunk world with more vibrant colors, deeper contrasts, and glowing details in the shadows. If you have an HDR-compatible monitor, you’re in for a stunning visual experience.

[h3]Steam Cloud Support[/h3]
Worried about losing your game progress? Fear no more! We’ve added Steam Cloud support to DeTechtive 2112. Your game saves will now sync automatically across devices, making it easier than ever to pick up right where you left off.

[h3]Enemy and AI Balancing[/h3]
We’ve fine-tuned enemy behaviors and AI responses based on player feedback. Our goal was to make the experience smarter but fairer. Enemies now act more naturally and respond strategically, while the overall difficulty levels have been adjusted to offer a balanced experience for both new and seasoned players.

[h3]Performance Optimizations[/h3]
To ensure a smoother experience, we’ve conducted a major performance optimization pass. The game now runs better on lower-end hardware, with improved loading times and overall frame rate stability (FPS).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/e3cd8cb8a66f0f293de752416192bca2fb699aef.png[/img]

These updates are just a few of the steps we’re taking to elevate the game. Your feedback is incredibly important to us! Please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions.

See you in the next update!
Until then, stay sharp in the cyberpunk world.

The DeTechtive 2112 Team

notes.title: Developer's Log 4
notes.notes:
[b]Hello DeTechtive 2112 players![/b]

We're excited to update you on the latest changes and improvements we've made to the game! In this devlog, we'll be covering new features in the co-op mode, enemy balancing updates, and several other exciting additions. Here’s what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/1581d45399bd30025215a56e2e4e3daca0185887.png[/img]

In co-op mode, each player will wear different detective costumes that reflect their personal style! Every player will have their own unique visual identity in the game world, allowing each member of the team to customize their detective. This customization will make the gameplay more fun and engaging.

[h3]2. Enemy Balancing Updates[/h3]
We’ve made improvements to the difficulty levels of the enemies in the game. Enemies are now placed more strategically, and difficulty levels will scale based on the player’s progression. This balancing will provide a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. Additionally, more strategic challenges will await you as you face off against your foes.

[h3]3. Changes to Some Mission Parts[/h3]
We’ve made adjustments to some missions, making their flow more interesting and dynamic. Certain sections of missions have been reorganized, providing fresh challenges and enhancing the overall experience.

[h3]4. New Sound Effects Added to the Game[/h3]
We’ve focused on enhancing the sound design by adding several new sound effects to the game. These effects will strengthen the atmosphere and make action moments even more thrilling. Every new sound will bring you closer to interacting with the world and make your gaming experience feel more immersive.

Future Plans These updates are just the beginning! As we continue to develop DeTechtive 2112, we plan to bring you even more content and improvements in future updates. Don’t forget to check out our Steam page to stay updated on all the latest news and developments!

Stay tuned, and have fun!

The DeTechtive 2112 Development Team

notes.title: Developer Diary 3
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Detechtive 2112 Community![/b]

Based on your valuable feedback, we have implemented several new features and improvements during the development of our game. In this devlog, we will focus on five major updates we've recently worked on. Let's dive into the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/e3cd8cb8a66f0f293de752416192bca2fb699aef.png[/img]

[b]1. Steam Friend Invite System[/b]

You can now play Detechtive 2112 with your friends more easily! We've integrated Steam's Friend Invite System, allowing you to invite your friends to your game with a single click. This feature makes cooperative gameplay, especially in co-op missions, even more enjoyable and seamless.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/81566900e1d1c66eb60d684b171fea111b2a736a.jpg[/img]


[b]2. Weapon Stats in the Interface[/b]

Each weapon in the game has unique attributes. To make these differences more comprehensible, we've updated the interface. Now, when you select a weapon, you can see details such as:

[list]
[*] Damage,
[*] Range,
[*] Recoil level,
[*] Silencer compatibility.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/0b64801d3a65809795d3e120fc5e35307a761802.jpg[/img]


This enhancement will help you choose weapons that better suit your playstyle.

[b]3. Ammo Types and Management System[/b]

Standard bullets, armor-piercing rounds, and special effect ammo! We've added new ammo types to the game and developed a management system to handle them efficiently. Now you can:

[list]
[*] Easily monitor your ammo stock,
[*] Quickly switch between ammo types,
[*] Add more strategic depth to combat situations.
[/list]

[b]4. Footstep Sounds Based on Surface[/b]

The type of surface you’re walking on now directly impacts the sound mechanics in the game. 

[b]5. Lighting and Level Adjustments[/b]

Lighting, a key element of the cyberpunk atmosphere, has been significantly improved. Neon sign glows, shadow details, and reflections have been enhanced for a more immersive experience. Additionally, we’ve redesigned some levels where players faced navigation issues, ensuring smoother gameplay. These changes make the game’s atmosphere and flow even more captivating.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/4c3d40e45d899ad4f2aa5e6c1cdd485f1aa89aed.jpg[/img]

Don’t forget to share your thoughts in the comments. See you in the next update!

Best regards,Detechtive 2112 Development Team

notes.title: Developer Diary
notes.notes:
Hello, DeTechtive 2112 Community!

In this developer diary, we’re diving into two key elements that enhance the atmosphere of our game: sound design and lighting. Our team has been working tirelessly to make every corner of our cyberpunk world feel more alive and immersive. Here’s what we’ve been up to!

🛠️ A Living World Through Sound Design
We’ve made extensive improvements to the sound design of DeTechtive 2112 to enrich the experience. Here are the highlights:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/cc3770b2b65285b98119caf6895f302f8598ded6.png[/img]
[h3]Street Sounds and Neon Signs:[/h3]
As you wander the neon-lit streets, you’ll hear an immersive ambient soundscape. From the static hum of electronic billboards to the subtle vibrations of neon lights, every detail has been designed to make you feel like you’re truly part of the city.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/344ab29a9da14b633090f768b2e0fe1557c64253.png[/img]
[h3]Weapon Sounds: [/h3]
We’ve revamped the sounds for each weapon type, ensuring every gunshot, explosion, and reload feels distinct and impactful. Combat has never sounded so satisfying!

[h3]Interface Sounds:[/h3]
 To enhance the futuristic vibe, we’ve updated the menu and interface sound effects. New clicks and transitions blend seamlessly with the game’s high-tech aesthetic.

[h3]Enemy Sounds: [/h3]
Enemies are now as threatening to your ears as they are to your eyes. Each enemy type has unique sound effects, giving you audio cues for when they detect or attack you.

💡 Lighting: A New Glow for Our Cyberpunk World
Lighting is one of the most vital elements in shaping the atmosphere of DeTechtive 2112. We’ve made significant adjustments across various maps to improve both visuals and gameplay.
Neon lights are now brighter and more striking. As you explore, you’ll feel the interplay of shadows and light, bringing the streets to life.


[h3]Indoor Areas: [/h3]
Enhanced contrasts and smooth light transitions create a more immersive atmosphere, supporting stealth mechanics. Dark corners feel even more ominous.

[h3]Industrial Zones: [/h3]
Warm and cool light contrasts in factories and machine-filled environments add depth and texture to these areas.


Your Feedback Matters
Sound and lighting are at the heart of what makes DeTechtive 2112 a rich and engaging experience. We can’t wait for you to experience these updates for yourself. Let us know what you think and help us make the game even better!

Thank you,
The DeTechtive 2112 Development Team

notes.title: DeTechtive 2112 | Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Greetings dear followers of [b]DeTechtive 2112[/b],

Today we will be sharing our first devlog with you. In general, everything you wonder is available in this content.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/18aab3ccec19a45c879f715f176978a2bedf9843.png[/img]
[b]DeTechtive 2112[/b] is an action and adventure game set in a [b]futuristic cyber universe about a private detective. The game features a shooter genre[/b], offering players an [b]isometric perspective camera experience.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939288/391520474f5920d1006d8ab39a8d85d3bc0dbc16.png[/img]
DeTechtive 2112 is a tactical, stealth and action game with many systems. Let's examine these systems together.

[h1]Stealth[/h1]
[b]Stealth is a key element of our game,[/b] behind the system there are fundamental variables, from the enemy's noise level to their awareness. [b]You have to change your tactics according to the map and the rotations of the enemies.[/b]

[list]
[*] Sleep Darts
[*] Shocking
[*] Cameras
[*] Camera Dashboard
[*] Ventilation
[*] Enemy Traps
[*] Exploding Trap
[*] Alarm Trap
[*] Distraction
[*] Whistle
[*] Security Control Room
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
The situation that will be activated the moment enemies are detected, [b]our character throws his coat on our character in a cool way and we can clearly see the cybernetics in his body.[/b] After this situation, we start fighting the enemies in a brutal way. The bullets we shoot break the limbs of the enemies and throw them using ragdolls.

[list]
[*] Lethality (Brutal) //Under Development
The head, arms, legs can be crushed and severed.
[*] Ragdoll Physics
The body will react according to the type of weapon.
[*] Limb Amputation //Under Development
The head, arms, legs can be crushed and severed.
[/list]

[h1]Cybernetics[/h1]
[b]Cybernetics are a helpful skill set that can be used in both action and stealth[/b]. You can get [b]cybernetics from the cyber clinic in your neighborhood with the necessary materials and money.[/b] With each cybernetics you [b]put on your body, your character's appearance will become more robotic.[/b]

[u]Each part of the system has at least two selectable cybernetics. We will explore the system in depth in future devlogs.[/u]

[list]
[*] Head
Raven Eye
Focus
[*] Body
Translucent Skin
Chrome Skin
[*] Arm
Emp Hand Launcher
Minigun arm
[*] Leg
Dash
Splash
[/list]

That's all we can inform you for now, with each update we will get more into these systems, take care and goodbye.
